label: Classification Scheme Registry
description: Which classification scheme a Classification Assignment draws its classificationConceptCode from. This registry entry is what's SHACL-validated; the code itself is a plain string naming a value within that scheme, not independently validated against it -- see docs/06-properties-and-rules.md for why. Candid PCS Organization Types, Transaction Types, and Support Strategies are registered here as valid facets but not yet populated as their own reference-data files -- add them when real data needs them, following candid-pcs-subjects.json/candid-pcs-populations.json as the template.

values.label: Candid PCS Subjects
values.definition: Candid's Philanthropy Classification System subject facet -- what issue or subject a resource addresses or supports.

values.label: Candid PCS Populations
values.definition: Candid's Philanthropy Classification System population facet -- what population(s) a resource serves or describes.

values.label: Candid PCS Organization Types
values.definition: Candid's Philanthropy Classification System organization-type facet. Registered but not yet populated as its own reference-data file.

values.label: Candid PCS Transaction Types
values.definition: Candid's Philanthropy Classification System transaction-type facet -- the form through which support is provided or received. Registered but not yet populated as its own reference-data file.

values.label: Candid PCS Support Strategies
values.definition: Candid's Philanthropy Classification System support-strategy facet. Registered but not yet populated as its own reference-data file.

values.label: CommonGood Issue Areas
values.definition: This ontology's own Issue Area scheme (see issue-area.json), usable as a classification scheme in its own right alongside external taxonomies.
